fresh_source_search.method: Ego-browser official-result discovery and selected official primary page body reading

sources.title: Android Drawable resources
sources.read_scope: State list syntax/pressed-selected-activated-enabled descriptions, first-match ordering and default-last note
sources.observed: Pressed, selected, focused and activated differ; selector uses first match, not best match
sources.application_proposal: Separate transient and persistent state; render actual state with explicit state-combination priority

sources.title: WAI Button Pattern
sources.read_scope: About this pattern, toggle button naming/aria-pressed, basic keyboard interaction
sources.observed: Toggle buttons expose pressed state with stable labels; command buttons perform actions
sources.application_proposal: Use aria-pressed only for persistent button toggles, preserve native button behavior and stable names

sources.title: WCAG2.2 Use of Color
sources.observed: Color must not be the only visual signal of information/action/state
sources.application_proposal: Use high-contrast fill plus check/text and programmatic state

sources.title: WCAG2.2 Pointer Cancellation
sources.read_scope: SC2.5.2, up-event activation and abort/undo explanation
sources.observed: Ordinary activation can be committed on release with cancellation opportunity
sources.application_proposal: Do not execute/leave persistent selection just because pointer-down or cancelled press occurred

sources.title: Android View API
sources.observed: Selection differs from focus; stateDescription supports accessibility and starts at API30
sources.application_proposal: Keep semantic/visual state consistent and guard newer APIs without assuming new AndroidX dependencies

sources.title: Android MotionEvent API
sources.observed: Current gesture is aborted and its normal action must not be performed
sources.application_proposal: Clear transient pointer/pressed state without committing action/selection

sources.title: WAI-ARIA1.2
sources.read_scope: aria-current complete attribute entry; aria-disabled and aria-busy selected entries
sources.observed: Current item differs from tab selection; disabled requires appropriate host behavior; busy marks ongoing updates
sources.application_proposal: Navigation current, persistent toggle and command progress use distinct semantics

sources.title: WCAG2.2 Status Messages
sources.read_scope: SC4.1.3/intent and selected sufficient technique references for status/error/progress
sources.observed: Important status changes can be exposed without focus moves
sources.application_proposal: Announce actual waiting/results/errors with appropriate live-region semantics; do not announce click as success

sources.title: Android Make apps more accessible
sources.read_scope: Increase text visibility, large controls/touch target and UI description paragraphs; current page Compose examples observed but not executed
sources.observed: Android recommends48dp touch targets, text contrast thresholds and meaningful labels
sources.application_proposal: Apply general visibility/target principles to existing Views without adopting Compose code or dependencies

sources.title: WCAG2.2 Resize Text
sources.observed: Web text can be resized to200percent without lost content/function
sources.application_proposal: Test labels/checks/results under enlarged text; do not treat CSS pixels as native dp

sources.title: WCAG2.2 Reflow
sources.observed: Ordinary vertical content reflows at320CSSpx; necessary2D content has an exception
sources.application_proposal: Keep toolbars/status usable at narrow width; do not blanket-exempt all controls because canvas is2D

sources.title: WCAG2.2 Non-text Contrast
sources.read_scope: SC1.4.11/intent, adjacent contrast and inactive-component exceptions
sources.observed: Required active UI/state cues need3:1 adjacent contrast, with stated exceptions
sources.application_proposal: Measure check/border/focus cues and preserve visible meaning under high contrast

cross_checks_and_corrections: Pressed is not selected/focused/activated; keep the actual state model authoritative
Android state lists use first match and default last; selected+pressed/disabled combinations need explicit review
WAI toggle aria-pressed requires a stable label; current navigation uses aria-current and true tab widgets use aria-selected
A click acknowledgement is not file-save/export/upload/import completion
ACTION_CANCEL and cancelled pointer input must not execute the normal action; ongoing async work is a separate lifecycle
aria-busy/aria-disabled meanings do not replace real completion checks or event blocking
API30 stateDescription requires compatibility handling; no new dependency assumed
Android48dp and webCSSpx criteria are distinct; current Android page examples being Compose does not require a Views migration
application_inferences: Single render source for actual screen/mode and visual/programmatic state
Do not persist transient press; restore checks from restored real screen/mode and dirty/save state
Guard stale async results against task/tab changes and restore previous actual selection after transition failure
Keep current screen check separate from one-shot save result messages
Validate dark fill plus check/text, keyboard focus, large text/reflow and screen-reader output together
not_verified: Real result export success or its SAF cancellation
Save-failure injection and broader async failure/recovery
preservation: Existing production sources, r16 acceptance, review snapshot and Cloudflare/VPN/external-configuration holds unchanged
